reason: Children argue for the intermediate state, refute the mirror-reflection example and prove the reasons with formal reasoning.
Children explain the intermediate being's form, identify the four existences with discussion, and list the eleven faults with a differing view.
The first child is a detailed account of womb entry and the third adds discussion of hell, god and other beings' entry.
Five children are one-line glosses but the last explains the reasons and raises and answers a doubt about pratyekabuddhas born from eggs.
Children only list the twelve links and gloss their grouping into three periods.
Children explain each of the twelve links in detail as states of the five aggregates across three lives.
Children set out the four kinds of dependent origination with a long quotation and answer a doubt about naming the links.
Children classify the links into afflictions, karma and bases and raise and answer a doubt about the brief treatment of past and future.
Children answer objections about the beginning and end of samsara and distinguish arising from arisen with reasoning.
Children refute two wrong views of ignorance with reasoned arguments.
Children present, extensively analyse by realm and summarise the eighteen mental approaches, including school differences.
Children explain the similes for afflictions, karma and bases point by point with reasons.
The third child raises and answers the doubt whether visible form is coarse food, with reasoning.
Children identify the other three foods as contaminated and state that they exist in all three realms.
Children gloss verse lines on the feeling and mind at death and the mind at final nirvana, each with a brief justification.
Children only give the depth of the water disc at formation and afterwards.
Children only give the diameter and circumference of the water and gold discs.
Children only give the heights and widths of Meru and the other mountains.
Children only state the location and widths of the seven lakes.
Children only describe the shape and measurements of each of the four continents.
Children only give the number, location and names of the neighbouring hells.
Children treat sun and moon, the calendar with commentary citations, the cause of lunar phases, and Meru's terraces and their inhabitants at length.
The third child is an extended multi-part description of the city, palace, parks, tree and assembly hall of the Thirty-three.
Children only gloss the apparent age and dress at birth of desire-realm and form-realm gods.
Children only identify the three desire-births and three bliss-births.
Children only define the thousand, second-order and third-order world systems.
Children only give the body heights of humans on the four continents.
Children only give the lifespans of humans on the continents.
Children only compute the lifespans of the desire-realm gods.
Children give the lifespans of form and formless gods and clarify which kalpa unit is meant.
Children only give the lifespans of the hot hells.
Children only give the lifespans of the cold hells.
Children only define the units up to a krośa and the distance of a hermitage.
Children only define the time units and the year with intercalary days.
Children explain at length the kalpas of destruction, formation and abiding, the great kalpa, and how buddhas, pratyekabuddhas and wheel-turners arise, with reasons.
Children narrate in detail how the first eon declined into property, kingship and the ten-year lifespan.
Children only identify the three lesser eons and give their durations.
Children gloss which element destroys which level, the peaks left intact, and the corresponding faults in one line each.
Children gloss in one line each why the fourth dhyāna is not destroyed by the elements and how it perishes.
Children only divide karma, identify its kinds, and state which are informative.
Children set out the Vaibhāṣika view and argue against the Vātsīputrīya and for the Sautrāntika positions with proofs.
